def VTask.ofLeftInverse {α : Sort u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) 
  (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α) 
  (hf : ∀ h, Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f) : α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) where
  toFun := λ a => ⟨f a, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩
  invFun := λ s => f_inv (exists_imp_nonempty s.2) s.1
  left_inv := λ a => by
    let h : Nonempty α := exists_imp_nonempty (Set.range.fself a)
    exact (hf h) a
  right_inv := λ s => by
    let h : Nonempty α := exists_imp_nonempty s.2
    have h_forall : ∀ y, (∃ a, f a = y) → f (f_inv h y) = y := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨a, hfa⟩ := hy
      calc
        f (f_inv h y) = f (f_inv h (f a)) := by rw [hfa]
        _ = f a := by rw [(hf h) a]
        _ = y := by rw [hfa]
    have hfa' : f (f_inv h s.1) = s.1 := h_forall s.1 s.2
    exact Subtype.eq hfa'
